notes: «رُوِيَ» is a passive verb, not a link; the chain starts at بكير
«أخيه زرارة» is one link, surface the name alone (rule 7)
Zurara asks the Imam («قلت لأبي عبد الله»): the Imam named in the words after the chain is the last link (owner ruling 2)
«جعلني الله فداك» and «عليه السلام» are blessings, left out
